title: Yellow Dense Vietnamese Semolina Banh Mi
description: A dense and umami weeknight Vietnamese dish featuring semolina rimacinata, this plant-based friendly banh mi is cooked in a cazuela and filled with fried goodness.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine semolina rimacinata, water, yeast, salt, and sugar, then stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased cazuela, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Bake the dough for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and cooked through.
While the dough is baking, heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and fry the tofu until it is crispy and golden brown.
Assemble the banh mi by slicing the baked semolina rimacinata in half and filling it with fried tofu, pickled carrots, cucumber, and sriracha mayo.
